scripts.test:launcher: uv run --project services/api --frozen --no-sync python -m pytest tests/launcher -q
scripts.test:web:jobs: pnpm --filter @llm-music/api-client build && pnpm --filter @llm-music/browser-tests exec playwright test --config jobs.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:web:transcription: pnpm --filter @llm-music/api-client build && pnpm --filter @llm-music/browser-tests exec playwright test --config transcription.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:web:generation: pnpm --filter @llm-music/api-client build && pnpm --filter @llm-music/browser-tests exec playwright test --config generation.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:web:runtime: pnpm --filter @llm-music/api-client build && pnpm --filter @llm-music/browser-tests exec playwright test --config runtime.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:web:score: pnpm --filter @llm-music/api-client build && pnpm --filter @llm-music/browser-tests exec playwright test --config score.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:web:score-generation: pnpm --filter @llm-music/api-client build && pnpm --filter @llm-music/browser-tests exec playwright test --config score-generation.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:web:gate: pnpm --filter @llm-music/api-client build && pnpm --filter @llm-music/browser-tests exec playwright test --config gate.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:web:gate:shutdown: uv run --project services/api --frozen --no-sync python -m pytest tests/browser/test_gate_shutdown.py -q
scripts.docs:check: node apps/docs/scripts/generate.mjs && node --test apps/docs/tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @llm-music/docs check
scripts.docs:build: node apps/docs/scripts/generate.mjs && pnpm --filter @llm-music/docs build && node apps/docs/scripts/check-build.mjs
